plugins.name: delivery-machine
plugins.description: The agentic delivery workflow: architect/builder/reviewer/verifier with two approval gates, services in tmux, a ledger only the verifier can close, proof-of-done, auto-handoff. Runs alone; gates arrive as terminal prompts.

plugins.name: mission-control
plugins.description: The cockpit: every tmux window as a live terminal in the browser, gates and questions as cards, proof gallery, fleet across projects. Install beside delivery-machine.
